era: Official YouTube Blog in 2019 (youtube.googleblog.com, Blogger Google-blog template; blog.youtube replaced it in 2020): #eee header band, YouTube logo + 'Official Blog' in light Roboto, 24px Roboto 400 post titles, 17px grey dates, #4184F3 links, flat post list with rules; no dark mode existed, the dark variant keeps the same flat layout on #181818

sources.shows: Official YouTube Blog home (Blogger Google-blog template, offline render of the capture with its own CSS): #eee 256px header band with YouTube logo and 'Official Blog' in Roboto 300 52px, list of posts with 24px Roboto 400 titles (rgba(0,0,0,.87)), 17px grey dates, Twitter/Facebook share icons, rules between posts; right sidebar with 'Search blog ...', Labels, Archive, Feed, Follow @youtube, Facebook Follow, 'Learn more in the YouTube Help Center'; links #4184F3
October 2019 archive page of the same blog: same header, post list with titles, dates and full post bodies (17px/32px text, inline images), labels

the template's own CSS in the capture: .header-outer #eee, .header-title h2 Roboto 300 52px #282828, #main .post .title a 24px 400, .publishdate 17px #757575, .post-content 17px/32px, a #4184F3, max-width 978px
